quotations.old_english: Þus gleáwlice (or adv.?) gástgerýnum sægdon sigerófum, swá fram Siluestre lírde wǽron
quotations.english: thus skilled in spiritual mysteries they told the victor (Constantine) as they were taught by Sylvester

source_text: gleáwlic. Add:--Þus gleáwlice (or adv.?) gástgerýnum sægdon sigerófum, swá fram Siluestre lírde wǽron thus skilled in spiritual mysteries they told the victor (Constantine) as they were taught by Sylvester, El. 189.
